LanguageData.AR_KinglyCommand.label: King's Command
LanguageData.AR_KinglyCommand.description:
The King of the Dead strengthens the other summoned spirits while he remains able to fight on their map.
• Movement speed: +(buff multiplier − 1) × 100%. • Melee cooldown: −(1 − 1/buff multiplier) × 100%. • Ranged cooldown: same reduction. • Aiming time: same reduction.
At x2: movement +100%, cooldowns and aiming time −50%. Actual numbers appear in each spirit's health tooltip. A health capacity of “Moving: 100%” is not its movement speed.
